translations.text: Thus says the Lord concerning the heads of the many waters that flowed and passed away: Though I afflicted you, I will not afflict you again.
Everyone who sees you will flee from you and say, “Nineveh has been plundered! Who will grieve for you? Where shall I seek a comforter for you?”
Your people within you are like women. The gates of your land will be opened to your enemies, and fire will consume your gate bars.
There fire will consume you, and the sword will destroy you. It will consume you like caterpillars, because you grew strong like caterpillars and multiplied like locusts.
